program.section_heading: Psychiatric Technology Associate of Science Degree
program.ge_pattern: SBVC General Education and Graduation Requirements or Cal-GETC - California General Education Transfer Curriculum
outcomes: Use an online simulated Psychiatric Technology State Board Certification examination (BVNPT) to prepare for the BVNPT licensure exam.
Apply safe and timely medication administration practices, including preparation and delivery of injections.
Apply and interpret therapeutic communication techniques during patient interactions, demonstrating respect for diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and communication needs.
Develop and discuss case studies/care plans to prioritize patient care.

The separate GE pattern (SBVC GE or Cal-GETC) is required only for the associate degree and has no units printed.
Total Units 67-71 matches the course list sum (Biology 4-8 + English 4 + Statistics 4 + Psychology 3 + PSYTCH 52) and excludes the GE pattern, so it was recorded as total_units, not degree_total.

Biology heading reads 'Select on course sequence (4-8 units)'; recorded as three option blocks. The catalog prints 8 units beside each two-course pair (BIOL 250 & 251; BIOL 260 & 261) rather than per course, so those per-course units are null and the 8 is in each block's stated.
Units for 'or' alternatives (ENGL C1000H, STAT C1000, STAT C1000H, ECON 208, PSYC C1000H) are not printed beside them and are left null.
The program learning outcomes are printed in the page's outcomes tab for the A.S. degree page as a whole; recorded here because it is the only outcomes list given.
